trigger: The primary families 1+2 to 5+19 transfer made P0574 6.63% worse than local light while the processed Lenstool reference was substantially better.
question: Is the raw-position failure caused by the arbitrary family split or finite FFT boundary convention?

split_robustness.rule: Enumerate all six unordered choices of two amplitude-calibration families and use the other two as held out; refit one positive amplitude per map on each calibration pair.
split_robustness.selection: No split may select a formula or tune a parameter. Report median gain and the count of splits where P0574 beats local light.

solver_robustness.rule: Repeat the primary split with two-, three-, and four-times zero padding using identical maps and source positions.

claim_limits: All family partitions reuse one cluster and the same 12 image positions; they test robustness, not independent replication.
The normalized map amplitude remains a fitted nuisance rather than an absolute gravity prediction.
The statistic remains source-plane scatter and does not perform full image-plane root finding.
Changing FFT padding probes one numerical boundary choice but not every potential-solver systematic.
